t: US Has Not Agreed on Transfer of Patriot Missiles to Ukraine by Third Country - Reports
d: The White House has not agreed on a transfer of interceptor missiles for Patriot air defense systems by a third country, The Washington Post reported, citing sources.

t: US Probing Ukraine's Narco Links to Mexican Drug Cartels - Russian Foreign Intel
d: Vladimir Zelensky's office has learned that US law enforcement agencies have obtained information about cooperation between the Ukrainian government and Mexican drug cartels, according to the Russian Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR).

t: Trump No Longer Counting on Zelensky - Analyst
d: US President Donald Trump does not count on Vladimir Zelensky anymore, so he is unlikely to care about Kiev's pledge to hold a presidential election soon after hostilities end, Turkish political analyst Oznur Bostan Ilyk told Sputnik.

t: UK to Send Typhoon Fighter Jets to Support Saudi Arabia - Defense Ministry
d: The United Kingdom will send Typhoon fighter jets to support Saudi Arabia amid the current escalation with Yemen's Ansar Allah movement, also known as the Houthis, the UK Defense Ministry said on Tuesday.

t: Dutch Gas Reserves at Minimal Level Ahead of Winter - Reports
d: Dutch state energy company Energie Beheer Nederland (EBN) estimates natural gas storage facilities to be 64% full, which is the lowest level required ahead of the heating season, the NOS broadcaster reported on Tuesday.

t: Rubio Discusses Energy Cooperation With Indian External Affairs Minister - State Dept.
d: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has discussed energy cooperation with Indian External Affairs Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar, the US Department of State said on Tuesday.
